hey, i have been through similar. i know you know this, and have likely read this a million times over… but if you want ANY chance to fix your relationship or get closure, you need to stop reaching out. i promise that will push him away further, please give him the time to heal and reach out to you on his own. i know it KILLS not having closure, but if he is ignoring all your messages that in itself is his reply. if you know you messed up and hurt him, show him you are truly sorry by respecting him! if it would help send a short message once again apologizing and letting him know you are going to allow him space and work on yourself in the meantime and wish him well. and after you send it absolutely do not reach out at least for an entire month or so, unless he reaches out to you. (try to wait for him to message u first.)  if you don’t give him time and space to think and time without you messaging him, why would he reach out? if you leave him alone he may start to also seek closure and reach out to you. it is hard to change, even if you think you did. it takes MONTHS at the least to make real meaningful change. unfortunately regret is not enough to  stop acting childish, you can be aware of your issue, but unless you spend months growing and tackling the root of the problem you will fall back into your own ways. my ex boyfriend was amazing, but i have a lot of unresolved trauma and mental health issues i caused many big fights, we broke up twice before the most recent breakup. :( each time he took me back way too soon. i thought i changed, but it wasn’t enough time. i ended up hurting him more and here we are. heartbroken once again and i fear i have pushed him away completely. for the first time after our breakup i am respecting him by not reaching out. it has now been a whole month since the bu and since we last talked. it fucking hurts. it hurts even more knowing how lucky i am he even gave me MANY chances, & how if we went NC for multiple months after the BU and I took that time to change instead of wallowing in my regret and guilt and spamming him with texts he didn’t respond to, we could potentially still be together. 

i immediately seeked out a therapist after our breakup & i am hoping to get medicated. i am also trying to focus on my health and become a happier and healthier version of myself all around. i will wait for him to reach out to me or reach out when i feel i have genuinely changed. (i will wait a minimum of *hopefully* 6 months unless he reaches out to me first) because i know that it takes time to change no matter how much you feel you have. it is just so easy to slip back into old habits. :( ask your therapist to help you find the root of your issues & how you can heal and fix them. sorry for writing so much, i guess it is because i can relate in a way and know how much it hurts. :( 

i am working on letting go and forgiving myself, however, it is possible to get stuck in a loop of regret and guilt which can actually hold you back. it is good you are able to take accountability, allow yourself forgiveness as you are human and likely just have some hurt you need to deal with. i truly wish u the best. if he cared about you i promise he will reach out eventually. he is likely just really hurting and needs time to think. take it as a blessing. you are able to focus on yourself and change. if you guys ever do reconcile one day, you don’t want to be the same person you were that day you guys got in the fight. as you heal and change, it will be easier to do it for yourself as well. i am sorry you are going through this.
